source_audit.causal_assessment: The remediation correctly models LimitFinder's ten-pixel UPolygon overscan for symbol-less EntityImageEmptyPackage folders. The account and Rust comment overgeneralize the style owner, however. GeneralImageBuilder sends an EMPTY_PACKAGE with non-null USymbol to EntityImageDescription, not EntityImageEmptyPackage. EntityImageDescription resolves the symbol-specific signature classDiagram.folder.title and uses the entity's style-builder snapshot, while Rust resolves classDiagram.package.title globally for every empty folder/package leaf.

findings.summary: Explicit folder leaves use a different Java image and style signature than the account claims.
findings.evidence: GeneralImageBuilder routes EMPTY_PACKAGE entities with a non-null USymbol to EntityImageDescription. That class resolves classDiagram.folder.title for USymbols.FOLDER, while Rust empty_package_round_corner unconditionally resolves classDiagram.package.title. The before-declaration selector held-out makes Java emit a zero-corner polygon and Rust emit a diameter-29 path; the odd package-only control makes Java retain diameter 5 while Rust uses 31.

findings.summary: Explicit-symbol style creation timing is also collapsed into the global package model.
findings.evidence: When conflicting folder/package styles follow an explicit folder declaration, Java retains its creation-time default folder-title style while Rust resolves the later global package-title style. This contradicts the account's creation-order perturbation axis for its stated explicit-symbol scope.

findings.summary: The zero-polygon frontier remediation works for the symbol-less EntityImageEmptyPackage branch.
findings.evidence: Both prior rejected zero cases now pass. Fresh nested and linked/multiple symbol-less zero-corner packages also match Java exactly, showing that the ten-pixel frontier correction generalizes across nesting and topology rather than matching one canvas.

findings.summary: No fixture-shaped shipping logic or unexplained production constant was found.
findings.evidence: The audited production changes use semantic package-kind and corner predicates, reuse the Java-cited LimitFinder constant, and contain no golden reads, fixture labels, or serialized-coordinate rewrites. The rejection is a missing Java model branch, not evidence of fixture overfitting.

verdict_reason: Although commit 8fc856c5 repairs and generalizes the symbol-less zero-polygon frontier, four fresh valid explicit-folder held-outs disprove the account's broader style-propagation invariant. Acceptance requires modeling EntityImageDescription's symbol-specific style signature and creation-time style ownership, then independently rechecking both branches.
